author: Lil Chyteil Modiya
text: Can't find my device photos even if I backed everything up. I can't also find it in my files. I didn't even "accidentally" delete it. Please fix this issue. I don't know what to do. Tried clearing the cache. The photos were very important to me.

author: Pan Nat
text: I can't find any of my photos that they took off of my gallery. I hate Google photos. this app takes my well organized photos off of my phone and organizes them in a way that I can't find anything. I don't want their storage. I am afraid to uninstall cus it may delete all of my photos. if I do get them back i will never be able to organize them the way I had them. oh! this makes me so mad. wish i could take googles photos, and scramble them up. HEY GOOGLE! Give me my photos back you thieves!

author: J.J. Wonder
text: This app is practically unusable anymore. The search engine doesn't ever freaking work when trying to find a specific photo, Even on Wi-Fi the page loads slow when trying to find a picture(Or doesn't load at all), It still doesn't have an option to where it can just save all of your photos/videos into albums without having to manually create them again. I'm only giving this 2 stars because it's one of the only ways that I know to backup my device photos without having to use a PC.

author: Justin Wren
text: Service has steadily declined for years now. Lots of features just completely don't work, for example saving a new frame from a motion photo. They removed the ability to search your photos if they aren't backed up. The cherry on top is recently they added an effect to your memories so that a large number comes in and shows you how many years it's been, unfortunately this new effect has ruined to quality of every single photo it shows. I really don't know how some of this leaves beta.

author: Matt Handler
text: this app used to be perfect, but the quality has gone downhill. the new ai search rarely finds the photos i want in comparison to the old search where i'd find my photos every time. there's also a recent bug where adding photos to an album sometimes creates duplicates, and they are really hard to get rid of. it seems to be related to a delay when pressing the button to add a collection of photos, sometimes this hangs for like 10 seconds and i think if i press it twice i get duplicates.

author: Jenn Goble
text: Photos used to be the perfect photos app. it had the best search funding of any app. I used to race iphone users to see how far we could find the same photo and I always won. Now this near perfect search function has been replaced by AI, which not only doesn't return the photos I'm looking for, it actually acts as a stumbling block to me finding them. It's slow and inefficient. Another perfectly good tool ruined in the name of trying to convince us that AI is inevitable.

author: Caroline Russell
text: Not intuitive for digital art, which most of my pictures are. The Memories and Face Recognition and such only pay attention to the (very few) actual photos and thus are not helpful. AI tools are trash. If this app wasn't conveniently synced to my Google account I would uninstall and find something else. Also, make the "folders" button easier to get to, and then STOP MOVING IT AROUND! And stop rearranging the order of the *comic panels* in my *album*.

author: Rebekah
text: This app DOES NOT duplicate photos, so if you plan on keeping your photos in the original app you were using, you won't. All of my albums are missing photos because they were taken and placed into google photos, once restored all the photos are mixed together. Also when the photo is "stacked" it only restores one photo. I have over 7,000 photos I was transferring and now everything is so disorganized and there's no easy way to fix it without spending hours trying to figure it out. I am so upset!

author: Kari Robinson
text: I am paying for Google photo storage for 3TB.... yet there is no customer support to help you when the features don't work. I finally got all my photos uploaded and the face recognition stopped working. it does not see that there is even a face....and when it does, it is not automatically tagging a person. I have face groups turned on, I have cleared the cache, and sent feedback multiple times with requests to email me to troubleshoot.... but I get no help.

author: Ryan Williams
text: Photos is forcing AI generated "creations" that use your photos. If you want to use the image search and ask questions about pictures, you have to have this enabled. There is no way to disable it. I have turned everything off except the AI itself so I can still image search, but it is analyzing my photos without me telling it to. And it's generating extremely ugly AI images and pinning them at the top of my gallery in giant tiles that can't be hidden... Yet another awful addition in a long line.

author: J Thomas
text: Search doesn't work like it used to, so it kind of makes this app worthless to me! With nearly 60k photos I can no longer search for SOME family and friends names in label descriptions I've make over many years, very frustrating. I've contaced google and they cannot find a resolution! Oh, and also something new, the app actually erases what I type on the description! I have to remember to copy text so I can cut and paste, or I have to retype everything!

author: Kat Willoughby
text: Good for photo storage and searching, but it sends too many memories/themed notifications each day and there isn't an option to fine-tune this other than to disable them. I like the occasional one to look back on but the current rate is pestering. Similarly, there's a pop-up (I think about AI editing of something? I dismiss it because I want to 👏 look 👏 at 👏 my 👏 photos when I open the app) that holds up using the app for what it's for. it's gotten pretty irritating to use.

author: Seagull
text: AI search is slower, less accurate, and more presumptuous than the version we had before. When AI search first came out, we even had a choice between the two, no longer. It's forced AI that interests the companies' surveillance more than the customers' choice, and I'll be switching to another storage provider as soon as possible. For work, I'd look up "maps" to pull up maps of locations I service, but the AI assumes I want Google Maps or "map view" and takes over my phone's control to switch.

author: Chris Hatfield-Lee
text: Their is a lot to like about the photo app. the editing tools are great and very easy to use. The new AI edits are quite impressive. However, facial recognition! This used to work well but has become a complete mess recently to the point it's useless to even try and search by name. Random people in backgrounds are being assigned key family members. It ignores 50% of the people clearly in the foreground. And there is no way to manually assign people to help fix errors, Apart from remove photo.

author: Jordan Wolf
text: I've been thinking about writing a review since the change in the way I can edit my own photos, but I thought it'd be fine. It's not. This sucks. Google lens is no longer in the suggested actions at the bottom, instead you have to tap on the three dots in the upper right corner, which is just unnecessary and annoying. The editor is actually trash now, like I'd rather download an extra app to edit/crop my pics and everytime I want to look through my albums it opens the search function.

author: David
text: They added search to the Add To Album popup! Someone *is* reading all those feedbacks I send!!! Easy backup of photos and videos. Nice interface for browsing photos and videos. Sometimes fails or errors out, but not too bad. Video creator is mostly automatic but I like the amount of tweaking it provides (adjusting music, filter, and titles).

author: Sabrina Absher
text: Loved Google Photos. Always demonstrating to people how easy it was to find a photo i.e. 'Dog in a hat'. Now the search has changed to AI and it's terrible. Even changing to classic, the same search will show your photo briefly, then change to 'Nothing found' or a huge list of random garbage. I cannot search anything. So sad. I have thousands of photos in storage. Google was my end all, be all.

author: Robert N Chase
text: Change is sometimes difficult. Finding specific photos varies between easy and challenging, depending on both Google's and your interpretation of search words. The latest changes have made it more difficult to find photos by people's names.. Those albums have disappeared from easy view; you have to figure out how to find them.

author: Nayanthara moly Saji
text: Google Photos is one of the best apps for storing and organizing photos. It automatically backs up your images, offers powerful search features, and groups faces and places accurately. The editing tools are simple yet effective. The cloud storage helps free up space on your phone. Some features now require a subscription, but overall it’s a reliable and smart photo management app.

text: RUBBISH BIN

author: Panthula Charan Raj
text: The lack of end-to-end encryption for cloud backups makes Google Photos feel really insecure, and the risk of data breaches or Google having access to my private memories is a major concern. I don't feel safe trusting it with my personal photos, so I can't recommend it.
